title: Lapse-Age Scaling of the RentGuard Reinstatement Fee
content:
The fee basis of the reinstatement fee on a RentGuard Renters Policy is scaled by the age of the lapse, counted in calendar days from the cancellation date recorded as the policy's closed date to today.

When those days are 7 or fewer, the fee basis is multiplied by 0.5; when they are more than 20, it is multiplied by 1.5; when they are more than 7 but no more than 20, it is taken once.

## Decision table

| Calendar days from the cancellation date to today | Fee basis is |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | multiplied by 0.5 |
| more than 7 but no more than 20 | taken once |
| more than 20 | multiplied by 1.5 |

The scaling applies to the fee basis before anything is added to the fee or taken off it.

## Boundaries

- 7 days: multiplied by 0.5; 8 days: taken once.
- 20 days: taken once; 21 days: multiplied by 1.5.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

For a hypothetical fee basis of 15.00:

| Days since the cancellation date | Scaled fee basis |
|---|---|
| 5 | 7.50 |
| 7 | 7.50 |
| 8 | 15.00 |
| 20 | 15.00 |
| 21 | 22.50 |
